name: Find and Replace
description: Find and replace across the page, with VS Code-style ⌘D occurrence selection — the find & replace Thymer doesn't have yet.
instructions: ⌘G moves the selection to the next occurrence, ⌘⇧G to the previous — one selection that hops. ⌘D instead grows a selection one occurrence at a time (⌥⌘D drops the last); type a replacement and press Enter to rewrite them all. ⌘⇧A takes every occurrence, ⌘F opens find & replace. ⌘Z reverts a replace, ⌘⇧Z re-applies it. Rebind everything in: Plugin: Find and Replace.
author: @akaready
